integrity: Reproducible, fully specified exhaustive algorithms agree on every radius frequency and extremal orbit. The package contains complete C++17 source code, raw counts, and a standalone replay script.
scientific_limitations: A complete finite census for five labeled states and exactly two distinguished letters. The established general pair upper bound and the Černý witness are prior results. No large-state extrapolation or independent external validation is asserted; unindexed prior enumeration is a residual priority risk.
title: Exact pair-synchronization-radius distribution of five-state binary automata
